title: English Practice Quiz 0468
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.

questions.question: A visitor asks, 'Where is reception?' You say:
options: It is near the main entrance.
questions.explanation: Give a clear location using a complete sentence.

questions.question: I have ___ my keys.
questions.explanation: Lost is the past participle of lose.

questions.question: I want ___ English fluently.
questions.explanation: Want is followed by a to-infinitive.

questions.question: I saw ___ elephant at the zoo.
questions.explanation: Use an before a vowel sound.

questions.question: Read: 'The shop closes at 9 p.m., but it opens at 10 a.m.' When does it open?
questions.explanation: The opening time given is 10 a.m.

questions.question: The work ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive uses will be + past participle.

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form.
questions.explanation: The comparative form of the short adjective tall is taller.

questions.question: The hospital is ___ the bank and the post office.
questions.explanation: Between is used for a position separating two things.

questions.question: Choose the correct WH question for a place.
questions.explanation: Where asks about a place or location.
